card.name: Start of antiviral and antifungal drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name that is split into parts, such as the P after glecaprevir, or the I in ibrutinib and itraconazole, usually in interaction lists.

modes.label: Glecaprevir/pibrentasvir
modes.description: The P right after glecaprevir/ in a list of hepatitis C antivirals.

modes.label: Start of next listed drug
modes.description: The first letter or piece of a new drug name that starts a new item in an interaction list.

card.writes: It likely helps the model finish a drug name after its first piece, though the listed output tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a drug name that is split into parts, mainly in lists of interacting antivirals and similar drugs.
